programme.title: Underworld - O Submundo
programme.desc: Numa guerra que dura há séculos, os vampiros e lobisomens lutam pela supremacia do Submundo longe do olhar dos humanos. Mas agora os lobisomens planeiam raptar um jovem médico humano para criar uma nova e invencível espécie. Apenas Selene, uma guerreira vampira, pode impedir este plano.

programme.title: Eu, Alex Cross
programme.desc: Alex Cross é um detetive de homicídios de Detroit que vai ser levado a todos os limites físicos e morais qusndo tem de lidar com um assassino contratado que se especializa em dor e tortura.

programme.title: Mark Felt - O Homem Que Derrubou A Casa Branca
programme.desc: Esta é a história do anónimo mais famoso da história americana Mark Felt, o vice-presidente do FBI que foi o Garganta Funda, o denunciante secreto que ajudou os jornalistas Bob Woodward e Carl Bernstein a revelarem o escândalo Watergate em 1972.

programme.title: Vencer A Qualquer Preço
programme.desc: Um jornalista irlandês da área desportiva tem a forte suspeita de que as prestações do ciclista Lance Armstrong nas vitórias da Volta à França foram conseguidas à base de substâncias proibidas, o que o leva a procurar pistas que hão de revelar toda a verdade sobre o atleta.

programme.title: Antes Do Adeus
programme.desc: Nick e Brooke são dois estranhos retidos em Manhattan durante a noite, que vão gradualmente tornar-se confidentes um do outro. À medida que as horas passam, o inesperado acontece e eles acabam por ser forçados a confrontar os seus medos e assumir o controlo das suas vidas.

programme.title: A Vida De Brad
programme.desc: Brad leva o filho a visitar várias universidades enquanto enfrenta uma crise pessoal ele compara a sua vida com a dos seus antigos colegas, hoje em dia todos ricos e bem sucedidos. Conseguirá o rapaz fazê-lo aperceber-se que ele até talvez tenha uma vida bem melhor que a de todos os outros

programme.title: Mulher De Ouro
programme.desc: Maria Altmann, uma octogenária judia austríaca refugiada nos EUA, não se vai deter perante nada para recuperar os bens da sua família apreendidos pelos nazis, entre eles um famoso quadro de Gustav Klimt, missão em que será ajudada por um corajoso mas inexperiente advogado.

programme.title: Flag Day Dias Perdidos
programme.desc: Jennifer Vogel tenta superar os destroços do passado ao mesmo tempo que concilia o laço inescapável com o seu pai, que vive uma vida dupla de falsificador, assaltante de bancos e vigarista para a conseguir sustentar.

programme.title: Força Da Natureza
programme.desc: Uma quadrilha de ladrões planeia um assalto num velho complexo de apartamentos de Porto Rico quando um grande furacão se abate sobre o local. Mas a tarefa vai ser complicada por um polícia que lá está destacado para evacuar o local e um ex-polícia ansioso por voltar ao ativo.

programme.title: Cidade Dividida
programme.desc: Na cidade de Nova Iorque, Billy Taggart, um ex-polícia caído em desgraça trabalha como investigador particular e é contratado pelo presidente da câmara de Nova Iorque, a quem deve um enorme favor, para espiar a sua mulher.

programme.title: Hércules - A Lenda Começa
programme.desc: Em 1200 a.C, na Grécia Antiga, o príncipe Hércules desconhece que é filho de Zeus e só deseja o amor da Princesa de Creta, prometida em casamento ao seu irmão. Agora, ele vai ter de fazer uma escolha fugir com o seu verdadeiro amor ou cumprir o seu destino e tornar-se o grande herói do seu tempo.

programme.title: O Informador
programme.desc: Peter Koslow é um ex-soldado das Operações Especiais que é recrutado pelo FBI para se tornar informador e derrubar o maior senhor do crime de Nova Iorque. Quando a operação corre mal, ele fica preso entre a máfia, a polícia e o FBI e terá de escapar para salvar a sua família.

programme.title: Parasitas
programme.desc: Uma família coreana no desemprego começa a ter um interesse peculiar por uma outra, com um estilo de vida cheio de glamour, até que todos se envolvem num acontecimento absolutamente inesperado.

programme.title: Pequeno Grande Guerreiro
programme.desc: Um velho soldado raso e um jovem general de um estado rival são os únicos sobreviventes de uma batalha terrível. O primeiro decide então raptar o segundo e levá-lo numa longa jornada cheia de peripécias para recolher a recompensa que lhe é devida.

programme.title: Zona De Perigo
programme.desc: Abby Trent é uma agente da CIA que gere uma prisão clandestina de alto risco. Quando capturam Hatchet, o homem mais perigoso do mundo e um mestre na arte da fuga, ele inicia um jogo sangrento, eliminando os oficiais um a um. Abby descobre que está rodeada de traidores. Em quem pode confiar

programme.title: Os Ingleses Estão A Chegar
programme.desc: Harriet e Peter Fox são um casal de vigaristas ingleses que, após perderem uma grande soma ao póquer e ficarem a dever dinheiro a uma gangster psicótica, fogem para Los Angeles onde acabam por criar um elaborado plano para roubar um anel à rica ex-mulher de Peter.

programme.title: Os Três Mosqueteiros
programme.desc: Ao lado de um jovem recruta ansioso por proteger o Rei de França, três leais espadachins tentam derrotar o pérfido conselheiro real e a sedutora espia enviada para derrubar a coroa.

programme.title: Serenidade
programme.desc: O passado misterioso do comandante de um navio de pesca regressa para o assombrar quando a sua ex-mulher insiste em abordá-lo com um desesperado pedido de ajuda, enredando a sua vida numa nova dimensão em que nada é o que parece.

programme.title: Por Amor
programme.desc: Walter é uma estrela em ascensão do wrestling universitário cuja irmã é brutalmente assassinada. Ao regressar à cidade natal, conhece uma mulher mais velha cujo marido também foi assassinado e a dor que partilham acaba por aproximá-los inesperadamente.

programme.title: Abbé Pierre Uma Vida De Causas
programme.desc: A vida de Henri Grouès, conhecido por Abade Pierre, desde os seus tempos na Resistência durante a II Guerra Mundial até às suas batalhas contra a pobreza e pela defesa dos sem-abrigo.

programme.title: Butchers Crossing Cruzamento Do Carniceiro
programme.desc: Em 1874, Will Andrews deixa a faculdade de Harvard rumo a Butchers Crossing, uma cidadezinha do Kansas, para se juntar a uma equipa de caçadores de bisontes. Mas a visão romântica que tinha da tarefa vai sofrer um duro revés quando a sua vida e a sua sanidade vão ser colocadas seriamente em risco.

programme.title: Mascarade
programme.desc: Quando um jovem gigolo se apaixona por uma irresistível vigarista, um esquema desonesto é concebido à luz do sol escaldante da Côte dAzur. Na busca de uma vida de luxo, irão os dois amantes tão longe a ponto de sacrificar o sustento de um agente imobiliário e de uma estrela de cinema reformada

programme.title: Gone - 12 Horas Para Viver
programme.desc: Jill Parrish está convencida que Molly, a sua irmã desaparecida, foi sequestrada pelo mesmo assassino em série de quem escapou no ano anterior. Mas será que Jill se encontra psicologicamente perturbada ou é a única que conhece a verdade, conseguindo encontrar Molly antes que seja tarde demais

programme.title: Machete Mata
programme.desc: O governo dos EUA recruta Machete para uma missão no México para deter um revolucionário psicopata que quer lançar um míssil nuclear em Washington.

programme.title: Stargate
programme.desc: O arqueólogo Daniel Jackson descobre como fazer funcionar um portal estelar descoberto debaixo de uma pirâmide. O coronel Jonathan Jack ONeil recebe a missão de acompanhar Jackson e uma pequena equipa de soldados americanos através do stargate para explorar a galáxia desconhecida do outro lado.

programme.title: Snitch - Infiltrado
programme.desc: Com o filho adolescente injustamente acusado de tráfico de droga, John Matthews faz um acordo para trabalhar numa perigosa missão como informador infiltrado junto de traficantes, arriscando tudo, incluindo a família e a própria vida.

programme.title: Entrevista Com O Hitman
programme.desc: Viktor é um assassino profissional romeno de elite, que fingiu a própria morte para mudar de vida mas cujo passado o vem perseguir e pôr em risco todos os seus planos.

programme.title: Sin City Mulher Fatal
programme.desc: Alguns dos cidadãos mais duros e resistentes da brutal metrópole que é Sin City cruzam-se com alguns dos seus habitantes mais sanguinários, em histórias de vingança e redenção.

programme.title: Golpe De Amor
programme.desc: Quando Richard percebe que a sua empresa foi vendida a um empresário fraudulento e que os fundos de pensões de todos os funcionários desapareceram, decide juntar-se à ex-mulher para recuperar o dinheiro, numa aventura pela Europa que envolve perseguições loucas e roubo de joias.

programme.title: A Balada De Adam Henry
programme.desc: Fiona Maye é uma juíza que tem de julgar o caso de um adolescente de 17 anos com leucemia que é Testemunha de Jeová e se recusa, por motivos religiosos, a receber uma transfusão de sangue que o poderá ajudar a salvar a vida.

programme.title: Thomas - Hamlet
programme.desc: Hamlet is a grand opera in five acts by the French composer Ambroise Thomas (1811-1896), with a libretto by Michel Carré and Jules Barbier. It is based on a French adaptation by Alexandre Dumas and Paul Meurice of Shakespeare's Hamlet. Thomas’ operas Mignon (1866) and Hamlet (1868) were largely neglected during the 20th century but experienced somewhat of a revival over the last decades.

programme.title: The LSO performs Boulanger, Dalbavie And Tchaikovsky
programme.desc: Polish conductor Marta Gardolinska conducts the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a concert program consisting of Lili Boulanger’s D’un Martin de Printemps, Marc-André Dalbavie’s Concerto for Flute, and Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 4 in F minor, Op. 36. The luminous optimism of the young Boulanger is poles apart from the raw passion and white-hot melodies of Tchaikovsky’s semi-autobiographical symphony.

programme.title: Documentary: Gianandrea Noseda
programme.desc: Although the great Italian composer Giuseppe Verdi applied unsuccessfully to study at the Milan Conservatory, this renowned college of music was eventually named after him. Today, the ‘Conservatorio Giuseppe Verdi’ counts numerous successful musicians among its alumni: from Giacomo Puccini, Alfredo Catalani, Claudio Abbado, Riccardo Chailly, Luigi Einaudi and Daniele Gatti, to Gianandrea Noseda.

programme.title: Schönberg - Pelleas und Melisande, Op. 5
programme.desc: Claudio Abbado leads the Gustav Mahler Youth Orchestra in a performance of Arnold Schönberg’s symphonic poem 'Pelleas und Melisande', Op. 5. With the encouragement of Richard Strauss, Schönberg composed the work during 1902-1903. The piece is inspired by a play about a doomed love by Belgian writer Maurice Maeterlinck.

programme.title: Schumann - Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. In this performance, Schwartz performs Faschingsschwank aus Wien, Op. 26 (Carnival Scenes from Vienna).

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: IVC 2021 - Final: Schumann, Sibelius a. o.
programme.desc: Baritone Arvid Fagerfjäll (Sweden, 1991) and pianist Hikaru Kanki (Japan, 1993) perform ‘Lust der Sturmnacht’ from Robert Schumann’s Kerner-Lieder, Op. 35; ‘Le diable dans la nuit’ from Henriëtte Bosmans’ Dix mélodies; Franz Schubert’s Totengräbers Heimweh, D.

programme.title: Haydn - Symphony No. 94, Hob. I:94
programme.desc: Joseph Haydn (1732-1809): Symphony No. 94 in G major 'Surprise'. Berliner Philharmoniker; conductor: Mariss Jansons. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991. The musicians commemorate the anniversary of the orchestra's founding on May 1st, 1882, playing in different European cities. This concert was recorded in the church 'Hagia Eirene' in Istanbul, Turkey.

programme.title: Shostakovich - 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87
programme.desc: English-French pianist David Levy performs Dmitri Shostakovich’s 24 Preludes and Fugues, Op. 87. The work is a set of twenty-four pieces for piano, one in each of the major and minor keys of the chromatic scale. Each piece is in two parts: a prelude followed by a fugue. The composer was doubtlessly inspired by J. S.

programme.title: Beethoven-String Quartet No. 6, Op. 18 No. 6
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: The Pianists Keys
programme.desc: This documentary by Christoph Keller follows various participants and teachers participating in the International Summer Piano Academy.

programme.title: Misha Enzovoort
programme.desc: Misha Mengelberg, the forgetting has begun. He is waiting for a taxi he didn’t call to go to a performance that won’t take place. Dutch composer/pianist and grand duke of jazz Misha Mengelberg (1935) has been submerged in the shadow of dementia, ending his life as a musician. At the London jazz club Vortex in 2013 he impressively says his goodbyes to the international stage.

programme.title: Beethoven - Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20
programme.desc: The soloists from the Lucerne Festival Orchestra present Ludwig van Beethoven’s Septet in E-flat major, Op. 20, which is scored for clarinet, horn, bassoon, violin, viola, cello and double bass. This 1799 piece achieved great popularity during Beethoven’s lifetime.

programme.title: Beethoven - Piano Concerto No. 5, 'Emperor'
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in a performance of Ludwig van Beethoven’s Piano Concerto No. 5 in E-flat major, Op. 73, famously known as the ‘Emperor’ Concerto. Italian pianist Beatrice Rana features as the soloist here. The New York Times describes her as ‘one of the most insightful and prodigiously gifted artists of the new generation’.

programme.title: Works by Gluck, Bach and Mozart
programme.desc: Venezuelan-born conductor Giovanni Guzzo leads the Camerata Fundación EDP of the Reina Sofía School of Music in a spirited concert. The program opens with the ethereal ‘Danza degli spiriti beati’ (Dance of the Blessed Spirits) from Christoph Willibald Gluck’s opera Orfeo ed Euridice, featuring flutist Matthew Raymond Origel. The concert continues with vocal masterworks, including J.S.

programme.title: Schumann - Davidsbündlertanze, Op. 6
programme.desc: After recording all 32 Ludwig van Beethoven piano sonatas to celebrate the composer's 250th birth anniversary, celebrated Italian pianist Riccardo Schwartz decided to record solo piano works by Robert Schumann. Davidsbündlertänze (Dances of the League of David), Op. 6, is a group of eighteen pieces for piano composed in 1837, named after Schumann's fictional music society Davidsbündler.

programme.title: J. S. Bach: Mass in B minor, BWV 232
programme.desc: In this concert, Herbert Blomstedt conducts the Gewandhaus Orchestra and Kammerchor for the last time as the Gewandhaus Music Director at the Leipzig Bachfest 2005. After seven successful years in Leipzig, the maestro performs J. S. Bach's Mass in B minor (BWV 232), one of the greatest works of church music ever written. Soloists are Ruth Ziesak (soprano), Anna Larsson (alto), Christoph Genz (tenor), and Dietrich Henschel (bass).

programme.title: Mahler - Songs of a Wayfarer
programme.desc: Mexican conductor José Areán leads the Orquesta Sinfónica de Minería in a performance of Gustav Mahler’s song cycle ‘Songs of a Wayfarer’ (Lieder eines fahrenden Gesellen). Baritone Jorge Lagunes is the soloist. Written in 1884-1885, the work consists of four songs, each based on one of the composer’s own poems, detailing a young man's unfortunate love and resulting journey through the world.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 9, Op. 125
programme.desc: Karita Mattila (soprano), Violeta Urmana (alto), Thomas Moser (tenor), Eike Wilm Schulte (bass), Swedish Radio Choir, Eric Ericson Chamber Choir, Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra, conductor: Claudio Abbado. Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827): Symphony No. 9 in D minor, Op. 125. The European Concert has been a tradition of the Berliner Philharmoniker since 1991.

programme.title: Symphony No. 3, in D minor
programme.desc: Mahler's Third Symphony, composed between 1895 and 1896, is an expansive, programmatic work that explores themes of nature, humanity, and spiritual ascent. It features a massive orchestra, a female choir, a children's choir, and a mezzo-soprano soloist, creating a vast soundscape depicting everything from nature's beauty to deeper philosophical questions about existence.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 12, Op. 127
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: Berlioz - Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14
programme.desc: Conductor Eduard Topchjan leads the Armenian National Philharmonic Orchestra in a performance of Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie fantastique, Op. 14. Berlioz wrote the piece of program music in 1830 while still a conservatory student.

programme.title: A Tribute to Vienna
programme.desc: Chamber music ensemble The Philharmonics pays tribute to the music of Vienna in this March 9, 2011 concert from Vienna's Café Sperl. The ensemble, which consists of musicians from the Vienna Philharmonic and the Berlin Philharmonic, performs arrangements of five popular waltzes by Johann Straus II. Among them are Kaiser-Walzer, Op. 437, and Schatz-Walzer, Op. 418, from the operetta The Gypsy Baron.

programme.title: Beethoven - Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55
programme.desc: Maestro Herbert Blomstedt makes his debut with the Lucerne Festival Orchestra at 2020’s Lucerne Festival conducting Ludwig van Beethoven’s celebrated Symphony No. 3 in E-flat major, Op. 55, “Eroica”. The sprightly Swedish conductor celebrated his 93rd birthday just one month before this performance. This remarkable performance was recorded at the Lucerne Culture and Congress Center (KKL), Switzerland, in August 2020.

programme.title: Tchaikovsky - Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13
programme.desc: Conrad van Alphen leads Sinfonia Rotterdam in a performance of Pyotr Ilyich Tchaikovsky’s Symphony No. 1 in G minor, Op. 13, ‘Winter Daydreams’, recorded at De Doelen in Rotterdam, the Netherlands in September 2022. Having completed a number of shorter orchestral works, Tchaikovsky embarked on a more ambitious project in March 1866: to write his first symphony.

programme.title: Verdi - La forza del destino
programme.desc: Renato Palumbo conducts the Orchestra and Choirs of the Opéra Royal de Wallonie-Liège in a performance of Giuseppe Verdi’s La forza del destino (The Force of Destiny). Verdi and his librettist Francesco Maria Piave based the work on a Spanish musical drama by Angel de Saavedra, ‘Don Álvaro o la fuerza del sino’. Composed for the imperial Russian opera in St. Petersburg, La forza premiered there in 1862.

programme.title: Bacchetti performs Bach, Haydn and Mozart
programme.desc: Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti appears both as conductor and soloist in this concert recorded at Teatro Chiabrera in the Italian city of Savona. He is accompanied by I Musici di Parma. On the program are J. S. Bach’s Prelude and Fugue in E major, BWV 878 (The Well-Tempered Clavier, Book II, No. 9), Joseph Haydn's Piano Concerto No. 11 in D major (Hob.

programme.title: Teatro Regio behind the scenes
programme.desc: Few Italian theatres can boast of being an absolute point of reference for national and world culture. The Teatro Regio in Turin is both a symbol of excellence in the national operatic tradition and a prestigious stage hosting operas, ballets, concerts, and musicals of great substance.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Le sacre du printemps
programme.desc: Maestro Bernard Haitink leads the Berliner Philharmoniker in a performance of Igor Stravinsky's Le sacre du printemps (‘The Rite of Spring’). Stravinksy composed the ballet’s score in 1913 for Sergei Diaghilev's itinerant ballet company Ballets Russes. The work’s sensational première at the Théâtre des Champs-Élysées in Paris caused a riot in the audience in response to the avant-garde nature of the music and choreography.

programme.title: Schubert - Four Impromptus, Op. 90: - I.
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Danielpour - Elegies
programme.desc: Richard Danielpour (*1956) is one of the most beloved American composers of his generation due to his frequent referencing of and connection with the past, being inspired by American icons such as Aaron Copland, Samuel Barber and Leonard Bernstein. His lush musical language is often infused with swingy jazz rhythms just as is the music of Copland and Bernstein.

programme.title: Glass - Double Concerto for Two Pianos
programme.desc: As part of a new collaboration with the famous composer of 'music with repetitive structures' Philip Glass, French pianists Katia and Marielle Labèque perform the European premiere of Glass's Concerto for two pianos with the Orchester de Paris conducted by Jaap van Zweden, current music director of the New York Philharmonic.

programme.title: Shusha Renaissance (2023)
programme.desc: “Shusha, the Renaissance” is a musical journey featuring pianist Murad Huseynov. The city of Shusha is often considered the cradle of Azerbaijan's music and poetry and one of the leading centres of the Azerbaijani culture, having been declared the cultural capital of Azerbaijan in January 2021. On the program are the following works: Fikret Amirov’s (1922-1984) Twelve Miniatures for Piano Solo: I. Ballade - II. Ashigsayagi – III.

programme.title: Beethoven - String Quartet No. 15, Op. 132
programme.desc: Renowned French string quartet Quatuor Ébène marked the 250th birth anniversary of Ludwig van Beethoven (1770-1827) with a remarkable project: recording all of the great composer’s sixteen string quartets. For five years, violinists Pierre Colombet and Gabriel Le Magadure, violist Marie Chilemme, and cellist Raphaël Merlin immersed themselves in Beethoven’s 650 pages of sheet music.

programme.title: The Unanswered Ives
programme.desc: “The Unanswered Ives” is the first documentary about American modernist composer Charles Ives (1874-1954). Ives was among the first generation of American composers that achieved international acclaim. Born in 1874, in Danbury, Connecticut, Ives took music lessons at a young age, becoming a church organist at the age of 14.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 13, KV 333
programme.desc: Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5 (KV. 283) and four Impromptus Op. 90 by Franz Schubert. The performance ends with Chopin's technically demanding Ballade No. 4, Op. 52. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: 'It would be hard to find anything greater, more significant or more moving anywhere in musical life today: total harmony of mind and heart, poetry and outcry, fear and consolation, knowing and feeling,' declared the Berne paper Der Bund after this stunning performance of Mahler's Resurrection Symphony in August 2003 by the newly founded Lucerne Festival Orchestra.

programme.title: Chamber music by Janácek, Taffanel and Prokofiev
programme.desc: This chamber music concert is part of the ‘Solistas del Siglo XXI’ concert series of the Reina Sofía School of Music in Madrid. First, Quinteto Zéphyros performs Leoš Janácek’s Mládí (‘Youth’) for wind sextet. This is followed by French flautist Paul Taffanel’s Wind Quintet in G minor, performed by Quinteto Scarlatti de Casa de la Moneda. The program closes with Sergei Prokofiev’s Quintet in G minor, Op. 39, played by Quinteto Cosan.

programme.title: Who has stolen the Boléro by Maurice Ravel?
programme.desc: One of the world’s most popular pieces of classical music, Maurice Ravel’s Boléro (1928), was no longer copyrighted as of May 1, 2016. Up to then it had made Ravel and his heirs millions. Ravel died in 1937 and left all he owned to his brother Edouard. Edouard’s death in 1960 unleashed a complex legal battle over the rights, involving among others Edouard’s nurse and her husband.

programme.title: Stravinsky - Le Sacre - II: Le Sacrifice
programme.desc: Every year, the Europakonzert is hosted by the Berliner Philharmoniker in a notorious concert hall or on a special location. This years concert is performed at the magnificent Royal Albert Hall in London. The Dutch conductor Bernard Haitink closes with Stravinsky's The Rite of Spring which he wrote in 1913 for Sergei Diaghilev's Ballets Russes.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Triple Concerto, Op. 56 And Symphonie Fantastique
programme.desc: Italian conductor Gianandrea Noseda leads the combined forces of the Music Academy KestonMAX fellows and London Symphony Orchestra (LSO) in Ludwig van Beethoven’s Triple Concerto in C major, Op. 56, and Hector Berlioz’s Symphonie Fantastique, Op. 14. Beethoven's Concerto for Violin, Cello, and Piano in C major, commonly known as the Triple Concerto, was composed from 1803 to 1804.

programme.title: Bach - Brandenburg Concerto No. 3
programme.desc: J. S. Bach’s six Brandenburg Concerto’s belong to his best-known works. The composer wrote these concertos between 1711 and 1720 and dedicated them in 1721 to Christian Ludwig, Margrave of Brandenburg. In celebration of the pieces’ 300th anniversary, Czech harpsichordist and conductor Václav Luks and the renowned Baroque ensemble Collegium 1704 recorded all six Brandenburg Concertos on historical instruments in 2021.

programme.title: Ice Dance: Sleeping Beauty (2013)
programme.desc: The award-winning Imperial Ice Stars are 26 Olympic, World, European and National Championship skaters, who jointly hold over 250 competition medals, performing theatrical ice dancing on a frozen theatre stage.

programme.title: Works for violin and piano by Corelli, Ravel a.o.
programme.desc: Japanese violinist Naoya Nishimura and Italian pianist Andrea Bacchetti perform an intimate recital recorded at the Munetsugu Hall in Nagoya, Japan. On the program are Arcangelo Corelli’s Violin Sonata in D minor, Op. 5 No. 12, “La Folia”; Ludwig van Beethoven’s Violin Sonata No. 5 in F major, Op.

programme.title: Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann
programme.desc: The film Jaroussky sings Bach And Telemann is a portrait of a very special vocalist, and of two exceptional composers. When Philippe Jaroussky - whose angelic voice seems almost timeless, not belonging to any one epoque or decade - sings works by Telemann and Bach, it becomes abundantly clear that the sheer emotional force and the purifying power of their music have not diminished over the centuries.

programme.title: Saint-Saëns - Polonaise for two pianos, Op. 77
programme.desc: On the occasion of her 80th birthday, Argentinian pianist Martha Argerich explored repertoire for piano and violin in this wonderful concert, recorded at Château de Chantilly, France. The ‘Grande Dame’ of the piano is joined by various renowned artists, including pianists Evgeny Kissin, Theodosia Ntokou, and Cristina Marton-Argerich, and violinist Maxim Vengerov. On the program are Dmitri Shostakovich’s Concertino for two pianos, Op.

programme.title: Brahms - Tragic Overture in D minor Op. 81
programme.desc: The Maggio Musicale Fiorentino (Florence Musical May) is Italy’s oldest opera and arts festival. It was founded in 1933 with the aim of presenting contemporary and forgotten operas. Over the years, the scope widened, and orchestral concerts have long been an integral part of the festival.

programme.title: Classica Spotlight
programme.desc: Cinematic classical clips and energizing concert pieces featuring up-and-coming artists.

programme.title: Mahler - Symphony No. 2
programme.desc: 'It would be hard to find anything greater, more significant or more moving anywhere in musical life today: total harmony of mind and heart, poetry and outcry, fear and consolation, knowing and feeling,' declared the Berne paper Der Bund after this stunning performance of Mahler's Resurrection Symphony in August 2003 by the newly founded Lucerne Festival Orchestra.

programme.title: Works by Beethoven and Saint-Saëns
programme.desc: In May and June 2021, Argentinian star pianist Martha Argerich celebrated her 80th birthday performing at Château de Chantilly, France. In this concert, recorded at the festival Les Coups de Cœur de Chantilly, Argerich is joined by three musicians who are particularly close to her heart: cellist Mischa Maisky, violinist Maxim Vengerov, and pianist Iddo Bar-Shaï.

programme.title: Mozart - Piano Sonata No. 5, KV 283
programme.desc: Italian pianist Roberto Prosseda (1975) performs Wolfgang Amadeus Mozart's Piano Sonata No. 5, KV. 283. Prosseda is particularly noted for his performances of newly discovered works by Mendelssohn and has recorded a nine-CD series for Decca of the piano works of Mendelssohn.

programme.title: Fantasymphony – A Concert of Fire and Magic
programme.desc: The Danish National Symphony Orchestra once again opens the gates to magical worlds with an enchanting concert program.

programme.title: Works for lute by J. S. Bach
programme.desc: French lutenist Thomas Dunford performs various works for lute by J. S. Bach in this intimate chamber music concert, recorded at Concertgebouw Brugge, Belgium, in 2017. On the program are Suite for lute in G minor, BWV 995; Suite for solo cello in G major (arr. for lute), BWV 1007; and Chaconne from Partita for solo violin in D minor (arr. lute), BWV 1004.

programme.title: In Rehearsal: Mariss Jansons
programme.desc: Latvian maestro Mariss Jansons (1943-2019) was one of the world’s leading conductors. He served as Music Director of the Oslo Philharmonic from 1979 to 2000, during which time he transformed the orchestra into a front-rank ensemble. Under his leadership, the orchestra toured extensively and became a favorite at major festivals worldwide.

programme.title: Sinfonía por el Perú from Philharmonie de Paris
programme.desc: Superstar tenor Juan Diego Flórez brings to life the most iconic roles of the bel canto repertoire, joined by the vibrant young musicians of Sinfonía por el Perú, led by the celebrated conductor Ana María Patiño-Osorio!

programme.title: Ressurreição: Ertugru T2 - Ep. 71
programme.desc: Na segunda temporada, a tribo Kayi alia-se aos clãs turcomanos para resistir à invasão mongol. Ertugrul é capturado e torturado, mas escapa e regressa para enfrentar a traição, o exílio e planos maquiavélicos. Expõe conspirações, resgata o seu filho, derrota Noyan e leva o seu povo para oeste para fundar um novo estado.

programme.title: O Jogo Do Destino - Ep. 109
programme.desc: Bahar abre um curso profissional num bairro pobre para ajudar as donas de casa, e aí conhece Demir. O conflito entre ambos começa com uma confusão ao comprar uma sobremesa e num acidente de mota. Apesar da tensão, forma-se um laço. Quando Bahar fica presa num incêndio, Demir arrisca a própria vida para a salvar. Entretanto, Aysun planeia vingar-se de Harun, planeando casar com ele, matá-lo e começar uma nova vida com Demir.

A história centra-se em Deniz, uma mulher inocente que tem tudo o que poderia desejar na vida, até que o marido desaparece sem deixar rasto. Após perder tudo o que possuía, vê-se numa situação desesperada e enfrenta uma luta diária pela sobrevivência, necessitando de lutar pelo bem dos seus filhos e do seu pai idoso.

programme.title: Spyro Gyra - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1982, the American jazz fusion band Spyro Gyra took the stage at the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Tania Maria: Live at Estival Lugano 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. This performance of Brazilian Tania Maria promises to make you want to dance.

programme.title: Rhoda Scott And La Velle: Hammond, Soul and Blues
programme.desc: American soul and jazz organist Rhoda Scott spent most of her career in France, where she earned recognition far greater than that accorded to her in the United States. There was never any doubt about what instrument she would play as a child. 'It's really the most beautiful instrument in the world,” she once stated in an interview. “The first thing I did was take my shoes off and work the pedals.

programme.title: Gregory Porter and Metronomy - Paris
programme.desc: In the 1960s, composer Michel Magne transformed the Château d'Hérouville, an 18th-century country house north of Paris and former home of lovers George Sand and Frédéric Chopin, into the first residential recording studio. In addition to its excellent facilities, the complex featured a swimming pool and a beautiful garden, allowing artists to stay for weeks or months at a time.

programme.title: Jazzed Out Berlin
programme.desc: Jazzed Out proves that a jazz session can take place anywhere. Unusual locations, such as garage buildings, multi-storey car parks, street corners, subway trains, and parks, in several of the world’s metropoles, provide the setting for brief jazz performances. The sheer rawness of the metropoles merge with the musical creations of various artists in search of the perfect ‘urban stage’.

programme.title: Invisible World - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Donna lee
programme.desc: The audience at the Montreal Jazz Festival in Canada was in for a treat on July 3, 1982, as a true musical innovator hit the stage: Jaco Pastorius, who transformed the electric bass into a formidable solo instrument. Combining intricate harmonics, fluid melodies, and unparalleled technical skill, Pastorius left a lasting impact on the music world.

programme.title: El Cahon
programme.desc: Regarded as the greatest instrumental soloist of all-time, Stanley Gayetzky, famously known as Stan Getz emerged as one of the most significant musical forces in the world of jazz post World War II. With his distinctively warm and lyrical tone, Getz is fondly dubbed as ‘The Sound’ because of his singularity and musical innovations.

programme.title: Cannery Row
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Duke Ellington Orchestra - Het Concertgebouw
programme.desc: The Royal Concertgebouw in Amsterdam is a world-renowned concert hall, known for its first-rate acoustics. It has attracted many famous performers over the years and is one of the Netherlands' most treasured musical institutions. On November 2, 1958, American jazz titan Duke Ellington and his Orchestra performed two concerts at the Concertgebouw in Amsterdam.

programme.title: Blue Note: A Story of Modern Jazz - Part II
programme.desc: Art Blakey, Dexter Gordon, Ron Carter, Herbie Hancock, Thelonious Monk... these names are synonymous with the great Jazz Age. But how many people know Alfred Lion and Francis Wolff, to whom we owe the recorded memory of our Jazz legends? Two German Jews who emigrated from Nazi Germany to New York 'discovered' an American art form which at the time received little serious attention from mainstream America: Jazz Music.

programme.title: Jazz de Matosinhos and Sinfónica do Porto: Layas
programme.desc: 30 minutes of... Orquestra Jazz de Matosinhos and Orquestra Sinfónica do Porto Casa da Música conducted by Dirk Brossé. Casa da Música is a performance hall located in Porto, in northern Portugal. Brossé, born in Ghent, Belgium in 1960, is a versatile composer and a respected conductor on the international music scene. Pianist Jason Moran and cellist J.A. Pereira de Sousa accompany both sets.

programme.title: Adagio from Concierto de Aranjuez
programme.desc: Formed in 1952 from the rhythm section of Dizzy Gillespie's big band, the Modern Jazz Quartet took its inspiration from classical chamber music as well as jazz's blues roots. The group enjoyed a decades-long career with multiple critically acclaimed albums, cementing their place in the history of the genre.

programme.title: Omar Sosa - Quarteto Afrocubano
programme.desc: While always keeping one foot firmly anchored in the traditions of his home country, Cuba, Omar Sosa tirelessly explores music from the Caribbean to India, and West Africa to the Arab world. Since he left Cuba in 1993, the pianist has been blending his Afro-Cuban roots with jazz, hip hop, electro and world music.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Ibrahim Maalouf
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Maceo Parker: Jazz à Juan
programme.desc: As a 25-year-old saxophonist, Maceo Parker played in the band of James Brown, but he is also known for his collaborations with George Clinton's Parliament-Funkadelic and Bootsy Collins' Rubber Band. Maceo has proven his star quality by creating a special chemistry between all the different styles of American black music. As a pioneer in the ‘groove’, he blends funky jazz with roots and blues with gospel. The result?

programme.title: Sun Ra Arkestra - Estival Jazz Lugano
programme.desc: Estival Jazz Lugano is an annual open-air music festival that takes place over five days at the picturesque city of Lugano, Switzerland. Since 1979, this musical Mecca has been a must-attend event for all jazz and world music fans worldwide. On July 3, 1985, pianist and space-faring jazz icon Sun Ra and his Arkestra crash-landed at Estival Jazz Lugano.

programme.title: BIRDtv: Bill Laurance Project
programme.desc: Rotterdam’s ‘ BIRD’ is a club, café and restaurant with a live music programme that's deeply rooted in jazz, and also branches out towards soul, funk, hip-hop and electronic music as well. Its name ‘BIRD’ refers to the nickname of the legendary New York jazz saxophonist, bebop co-founder Charlie Parker (1920-1955). BIRD serves Neapolitan pizzas, good wines, no-nonsense beers and an all-round metropolitan rawness.

programme.title: VEIN Plays Ravel
programme.desc: A sound support with provocative combinations, a modern music laboratory, a vehicle of inspiration whose importance has been proven by many high-profile collaborations. Music lovers who appreciate jazz for its ability to provoke and continuously question the status quo certainly do not expect that such a standard set in its configuration finds itself completely detached from tradition.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Tribute to Monk
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2017, French pianist Laurent de Wilde performed his tribute to jazz icon Thelonious Monk at Jazz à Vienne.

programme.title: O. Peterson Trio and S. Grappelli - Grand Gala
programme.desc: In the 1960s and 1970s, the annual Grand Gala du Disque was the awards ceremony during which the Edison Awards were presented to Dutch and international artists. These prestigious events were landmarks in the history of Dutch music broadcasting.

programme.title: Jazz Batá 2
programme.desc: Legendary Cuban pianist Chucho Valdés brought his band ‘Jazz Batá 2’ to the Malta Jazz Festival on July 19, 2019. The air was thick with anticipation as Valdés took to the stage, revisiting the small-group concept of his mythical 1972 Cuban album ‘Jazz Bata´’. The bata´ repertoire – the deep classical music of West Africa – permeates Valde´s’ piano solos throughout the concert.

programme.title: Louis Armstrong: Live in Australia
programme.desc: Following a highly successful small-group jazz concert at New York Town Hall on May 17, 1947, Armstrong's manager Joe Glaser dissolved the Armstrong big band on August 13, 1947 and established a six-piece small group. This group was called the All Stars, and in 1964 Louis Armstrong recorded his biggest-selling record, Hello, Dolly!

programme.title: The Crusaders: Estival Lugano 1987
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. The Crusaders, an American jazz fusion group that was popular in the '70s employed a two-manned front-line horn section.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2018, English trip-hop group Morcheeba performed at Jazz à Vienne.

programme.title: Belgium Sessions: Hijaz
programme.desc: In this DJAZZ Belgium Sessions performance, which was recorded at AED Studios in Lint, Belgium, we witness Europe’s finest jazz musicians at work. A wide variety of international jazz musicians give a creative, up-close and inside insight into their art of playing jazz music. Young talent and established jazz musicians play to their heart’s content: take for instance this unusual performance by the multi-ethnic ensemble Hijaz.

programme.title: Astrud Gilberto Band Live at Estival Lugano 1985
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence. “The Girl From Ipanema”, Astrud Gilberto’s second name. The Brazilian bossa-nova and samba singer gives an outstanding, swinging performance at Estival Lugano.

programme.title: Jon Hendricks and Co: Estival 1986
programme.desc: Since 1977, Estival is a summer jazz festival in Switzerland, Lugano. Estival offers a thrilling and particularly surprising line-up that explores the rich world of contemporary music whilst promoting the understanding of different cultures, tolerance, and co-existence.

programme.title: Morgenland: Songs Without Frontiers
programme.desc: Since 2005, the Morgenland Festival of Osnabrueck has dedicated itself to the fascinating music culture of the Near and Middle East. From traditional and classical music to avant-garde, jazz, and rock, the festival program also features art, such as visual arts, dance, and theatre of interdisciplinary projects.

programme.title: Great Jazz Pianists
programme.desc: Embark on a remarkable journey through the world of jazz piano as we showcase some of the most iconic and influential pianists in history. This collection of extraordinary performances captures the unique essence and brilliance of legendary pianists Art Tatum, Thelonious Monk, Bud Powell, and others. Revel in Oscar Peterson’s virtuosity as his trio plays “C-Jam Blues” in Holbaek, Denmark, on May 2, 1964.

programme.title: New Cool Collective - Melkweg, Amsterdam
programme.desc: New Cool Collective is one of the foremost Dutch jazz ensembles. Pioneering new blends of music styles since 1993, NCC has performed in various formations, from small combos to larger ensembles and even big bands! The ensemble’s high energy is cut out for the dance floors, as dance, Latin, salsa, afrobeat and boogaloo all meet in a jazzy mix.

programme.title: Earl Hines Quartet in Spa, 1977
programme.desc: Despite his advanced age, the legendary jazz pianist Earl Hines was at the top of his game when he performed in the Belgian town of Spa in 1977. With a band consisting of Rudy Rutherford (reeds), Jimmy Leary (bass), and Eddie Graham (drums), Hines livens up the room with his interpretations of “I Can’t Believe That You’re In Love With Me” and “The Man I Love.

programme.title: Jazz à Vienne
programme.desc: Jazz à Vienne is one of the world's most prestigious jazz festivals. Ever since 1981, it has attracted a mix of jazz legends and exciting newcomers, with many of them playing return engagements. Each year welcomes outstanding international stars to the historical Le Théâtre Antique to impress and inspire their audiences. In 2017, French pianist Amaury Faye performed with his trio at Jazz à Vienne.

programme.title: Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah, The Walk
programme.desc: In 2019, the vibrant city of Sofia, Bulgaria, hosted the International A to JazZ Festival. Among the featured acts was the trailblazing jazz trumpeter Christian Scott aTunde Adjuah. This genre-defying artist captivated the audience with his eclectic “stretch music”; an approach that incorporates hip-hop and reaches back through the American canon into African percussion and its rich melodic content.

programme.title: Love X Love
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by. In 1987, prominent guitarist George Benson brought his band to kick off day three of the North Sea Jazz Festival in The Hague.

programme.title: Michel Legrand Orchestra at Spa, 1982
programme.desc: Known outside jazz circles mainly for his film scores, French composer, arranger and pianist Michel Legrand has had a long and storied career in music. Interpreters of his compositions include jazz legends such as Sarah Vaughan, Stan Getz, and Bill Evans, as well as pop stars such as Barbra Streisand and Frank Sinatra.

programme.title: Germeringer Jazztage: Paco de Lucía And Group
programme.desc: This broadcast shows a rare appearance at the 1996 Germeringer Jazztage by the legendary flamenco guitarist Paco de Lucía and his sextet. Some may question the inclusion of a flamenco guitarist within a jazz festival.

programme.title: Duets: Carla Bley and Steve Swallow in 1988
programme.desc: If any two musicians share a special bond when they perform, it’s pianist Carla Bley and bassist Steve Swallow. The two have performed in the same bands since the 1960s and have been romantic partners for more than two decades. Watching them perform is the definition of musical telepathy. A glance or a smile?seems to change the feel of the music.

programme.title: Caravan
programme.desc: The legendary hard-bop group Art Blakey's Jazz Messengers performed in Olympia Hall in Paris, France on March 16, 1963. Led by drummer Art Blakey, the Jazz Messengers consisted of Wayne Shorter on tenor saxophone, Freddie Hubbard on trumpet, Curtis Fuller on trombone, Reggie Workman on double bass, and Cedar Walton on piano. Each of these players became jazz legends in their own right.

programme.title: Free Improvisation 2
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic. In 1988, vocalist Bobby McFerrin appeared at the festival.

programme.title: Wynton Marsalis: In This House, on This Morning
programme.desc: The final concert of the Münchner Klaviersommer 1992 was by Wynton Marsalis and his septet. The 31-years-young star trumpeter performed one of his own jazz suites to the sold-out Philharmonie, under the title of ‘In This House, On This Morning’. The concert covers every jazz style, in composition and improvisation, and in both small and grand forms.

programme.title: Moondog And The London Saxophonique
programme.desc: Moondog, a gaunt, mysterious and extravagantly-garbed blind street musician was celebrated among New Yorkers for two decades before gaining acclaim in Europe as an avant-garde composer conducting orchestras before royalty. Artists such as Charlie Parker, Leonard Bernstein, Steve Reich and Philip Glass have called him one of the great musical visionaries of our century.?Day in and day out, the man whose real name is Louis T.

programme.title: The New Conrad Miller Trio Live at Mocher's
programme.desc: Full-time pianist, composer, teacher, and producer Coen Molenaar – aka Conrad Miller – is active all over the world in styles ranging as widely as jazz, fusion, dance, funk, RAndB, rock, and neo-soul. In this 2021 performance from Rossini Studios in Stuttgart, Germany, Miller plays contemporary trio jazz with his bandmates David de Marez Oyens (double bass) and Enrique Firpi (drums).

programme.title: Burton Greene - OTO Part IV
programme.desc: Legendary free jazz pianist Burton Greene rose to fame in New York City's free jazz scene of the 1960s. Exploring various spontaneous improvisational styles, Greene performs live at Cafe OTO in London, UK.

programme.title: DJAZZ Portrait: Montreux
programme.desc: These portraits of artists, concerts and festivals give a good impression of the jazz world. Both famous and less famous jazz artists will give a new insight in their life. DJAZZ asked them why they wrote that special song, what was the first record they bought and what is his or her most precious musical memory. The festival portraits are beautiful reports filmed at the most special jazz festivals and concerts.

programme.title: Count Basie - North Sea Jazz Part II
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Trio Chemirani: Dawâr
programme.desc: The veritable tombak virtuosos of Trio Chemirani, consisting of Chemirani Senior and Juniors, enrapture the Festival de Saintes. The tombak is a Persian percussion instrument, but its rhythms are universal. The Trio Chemirani’s music is accessible to all and will certainly resound with each listener. The members of the trio, Djamchid Chemirani (born in Teheran in 1942) and his two sons and pupils Keyvan and Bijan, are living in France.

programme.title: Chick Corea Akoustic Band - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. The concerts were usually held in July at The Gasteig, home of the Munich Philharmonic.

programme.title: Live in France: Jimmy Smith
programme.desc: Jimmy Smith: Live in '69 boasts an incredible 90-minute concert from 1969 filmed in Paris. Working in his classic trio format with longtime guitarist Eddie McFadden and drummer Charlie Crosby, Jimmy shows why he is still the uncontested king of the jazz organ.

programme.title: Lionel Hampton Big Band - Kurhaus Scheveningen
programme.desc: The Kurhaus in Scheveningen is a grand hotel in the Netherlands renowned for attracting both royal and musical nobility. Doubling as a concert hall, it has been host to several heavy hitters, such as the Rolling Stones and Ike and Tina Turner. On August 2, 1983, American vibraphonist Lionel Hampton performed at the Kurhaus in Scheveningen.

programme.title: Hypnotic Brass Ensemble - Jazzwoche Burghausen
programme.desc: Every year since 1970, the German city of Burghausen has been hosting one of the largest jazz festivals in the world. During Burghausen International Jazz Week, Burghausen becomes a 'Bavarian jazz mecca': guests from all over the world join the Burghausers to enjoy the most wonderful jazz performances as the colorful hustle and bustle of spectators and musicians shake up the city.

programme.title: Benny Goodman Septet - North Sea Jazz Part II
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: PC Qwintett: 75th year of Courbois
programme.desc: Pierre Courbois has been one of Europe’s leading jazz musicians since the mid-sixties. This concert, recorded at the renowned Amsterdam jazz club Bimhuis, sees the drummer playing with his QWINTETT. On the occasion of his 75th birthday in 2015, Courbois hit the road for the Pierre Courbois 75 Years Anniversary Tour.

programme.title: Duke Ellington live at the Concertgebouw Amsterdam
programme.desc: Duke Ellington: Live in '58 features the earliest-known filmed full-length concert by one of the 20th Century's greatest songwriters and bandleaders. Filmed at Amsterdam's famed Concertgebouw, this 80-minute concert features the 16-piece Duke Ellington Orchestra two years after their stunning performance at the 1956 Newport Jazz Festival, which Duke considered his second birth.

programme.title: S. Quintet, Hubbard And Henderson - North Sea Jazz
programme.desc: The North Sea Jazz Festival is the largest indoor music festival in the world, known globally as the event where the past, present and future of jazz are featured within three days. Next to a firm base of jazz as the festival’s staple music genre, many others, such as blues, soul, funk, or hip hop, pass by.

programme.title: Bakolo Music International - WOMEX 2018
programme.desc: Since 1994, World Music Expo (WOMEX) has been attracting musicians, agents, a great number of press agencies, as well as media companies from all over the world. Its main exposition event has been held in various locations throughout Europe, including Berlin, Brussels, Marseille, Stockholm, Seville, Cardiff, and Budapest. In 2018, WOMEX was held in Las Palmas, Gran Canaria.

programme.title: Joe Zawinul - Münchner Klaviersommer
programme.desc: 'Münchner Klaviersommer' was an annual concerts series that took place from 1981 to 1998 in Munich, Germany. Although the festival's name suggests a strong focus on piano music, it featured countless famous musicians from jazz and classical music – not just pianists. In 1985, Viennese keyboardist Joe Zawinul was one of the artists appearing at this festival.

programme.title: Pantanal - Ep. 20
programme.desc: Jove diz a José Leôncio que não tem a intenção de viver no Pantanal. Muda fica aterrorizada ao ouvir o Velho do Rio contar para Juma sobre a morte do jagunço que matou Maria Marruá. José Leôncio se emociona quando Jove pede para Tibério tocar uma música que o avô gostava. Juma ameaça Muda ao vê-la com a espingarda apontada para a onça Marruá. programme.title: Império - Ep. 146

Jéssica não consegue convencer Clô a perdoar Jackie. Clara se desculpa com Mimi e conta a sua história para ele.

programme.title: Orgulho E Paixão - Ep. 87
programme.desc: Lady Margareth ofende Elisabeta e Darcy a defende. Ema rompe seu noivado com Edmundo. Josephine afirma a Rômulo que Tibúrcio não a socorreu no lago, quando ela se afogou. Ernesto afirma a Mariko que desistiu de Ema. Luccino descobre que Fani sabia que Josephine estava viva. Mariana revela seu disfarce para Cecília. Edmundo enfrenta Tibúrcio. Lady Margareth demite Elisabeta e Venâncio.

programme.title: A Nobreza Do Amor - Ep. 77

Casemiro entrega armas a Tonho e pede que o rapaz defenda o engenho. Alika deduz que Jendal descobriu seu paradeiro. Sebastião conta a Virgínia que contratou o cangaceiro que ela pediu para destruir o ateliê.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: Scorpions - Moment Of Glory
programme.desc: This concert from the Scorpions home city of Hanover was the climax of EXPO2000. The legendary German rock band, with worldwide album sales in excess of 75 million, perform live on stage with the perhaps even more legendary Berlin Philharmonic Orchestra conducted by Christian Kolonovits.

programme.title: The Strokes - Live at Landmark Music Festival
programme.desc: And as with other hugely successful rock bands, it was the lead singer who was in charge of pumping up the crowd, with Julian Casablancas yelling things like “D.C., let’s rock!” and “What’s up, D.C.?!” The crowd went wild, but to Casablancas, it was clearly a joke. He was playing a role and said as much outright at the beginning of the show, but that didn’t stop the crowd, hungry for more entertainment, from taking him seriously.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits
programme.desc: A selection of our best concert previews and exclusive interviews.

programme.title: Kylie Minogue - Live in London
programme.desc: Two hours of classic Kylie, capturing the energy, grandeur and extravagance of the massively acclaimed Aphrodite: Les Folies tour. Filmed at Kylie's triumphant O2 Arena show in London, this concert film was produced using a lavishly hi-tech multi-camera shoot affording the viewer a spectacular experience from start to finish.

programme.title: Oasis - Live at Wembley Arena 2008
programme.desc: Filmed at Wembley Arena, London, this concert film will give all fans a spectacular Live experience from start to finish. Classic Oasis featuring unforgettable version of their hits: 'Champagne Supernova', 'Don’t Look Back In Anger', 'Rock N Roll Star' and many more.

programme.title: Various Artists - iConcerts Hits

programme.title: The Moody Blues - Days of Future Passed Live
programme.desc: Celebrating the 50th anniversary of their landmark album, Days of Future Passed, The Moody Blues took to the road to perform the entire LP live. This film, capturing an electric evening at The Sony Centre, Toronto, where the band was joined on stage by a full orchestra for the first time ever, is the definitive performance of this seminal album.

programme.title: Iggy Pop - Austin City Limits
programme.desc: The Austin City Limits Music Festival is an annual music festival that takes place at Zilker Park in Austin, Texas. The festival features more than 130 bands on eight stages for three days.

programme.title: Ziggy Marley - Live at The Filmore
programme.desc: The Fillmore Auditorium is a historic concert hall in San Francisco, California. Founded by Bill Graham, it was named after being located originally on the corners of Fillmore Street and Geary Boulevard.

programme.title: Milky Chance - Garorock Festival 2017
programme.desc: The German duet is back and better than ever! Milky Chance is the success story of two school friends, Clemens Rehbein and Philipp Dausch. After a long break, 2017 marks the release of a second, long-waited, album 'Blossom'. And, for the public, finally the occasion to discover live these new compositions, mixing rock, folk and electro pop.

programme.title: A História E O Conhecimento - Ep. 10
programme.desc: Documentários. Following the Messiah - parte 3.

programme.title: ABC Da Família - Ep. 43
programme.desc: Programa destinado a todas as pessoas que desejem conhecer a vontade de Deus para a sua vida e família, incluindo temas diversificados que permitem a construção da familia baseada na palavra de Deus e também temas dedicados especialmente às mulheres.

programme.title: ABC Da Família - Ep. 44
programme.desc: Programa destinado a todas as pessoas que desejem conhecer a vontade de Deus para a sua vida e família, incluindo temas diversificados que permitem a construção da familia baseada na palavra de Deus e também temas dedicados especialmente às mulheres.

programme.title: A Rota T9 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Programa de índole cultural onde se viaja pelo mundo à descoberta da história, cultura e gastronomia dos locais.Com reportagens produzidas localmente em diferentes países e eventos, as nossas viagens são feitas por uma equipa, que se deslocam de avião, barco ou carro à procura de novos territórios para explorar e novas aventuras para experienciar.

programme.title: Vidas Transformadas T4 - Ep. 24
programme.desc: Vidas Transformadas é um programa baseado em testemunhos reais do que Deus está a fazer na vida das pessoas.

programme.title: Política And Religião - Ep. 9
programme.desc: O programa terá a presença do Apóstolo Jorge Tadeu, onde serão abordados vários temas da atualidade sobre a POLÍTICA vs o que a BÍBLIA fala.

programme.title: Maná World T2 - Ep. 121
programme.desc: Maná World é um programa que pretende dar a conhecer quem é a Igreja Maná, quem somos, o que fazemos e onde estamos, apresenta a biografia do Apóstolo Jorge Tadeu, mostrando vários departamentos do Ministério Maná.

programme.title: Aprenda A Gerir O Seu Dinheiro - Ep. 23
programme.desc: APRENDA A GERIR O SEU DINHEIRO, ensina sobre leis para poder vencer na área financeira, um programa que consiste em passar lições do Apóstolo Jorge Tadeu sobre Área Financeira.

programme.title: Espaço Mulher - Ep. 3
programme.desc: Programa destinado a todas as mulheres que desejam conhecer a vontade de Deus para a sua vida e família, temas diversificados que a vão prender ao ecra.

programme.title: 60 Minutos Com Deus T3 - Ep. 800
programme.desc: É um programa direcionado às famílias, onde abrangemos temas como, saúde, casamento, área financeira, com o intuito de ajudar a vencer, educando na fé cristã.

programme.title: Informação Ao Minuto T3 - Ep. 86
programme.desc: É o espaço noticioso diário que leva até si, de forma clara e imediata, os acontecimentos que marcam a atualidade nacional e internacional. Com uma abordagem rigorosa e acessível, o programa cedido pela TV Maná 1 à Kuriakos TV, destaca os temas mais relevantes do momento — da política à economia, da sociedade à cultura — garantindo uma informação atualizada e de confiança.

programme.title: Na Rota Dos Angolanos T2 - Ep. 11
programme.desc: Programa de índole cultural onde se viaja à descoberta dos angolanos espalhados por todo o mundo, com reportagens produzidas não só em Angola mas também um pouco por todo o mundo onde se encontrem angolanos.Com uma componente humana e social sempre presente, faz parte integrante dos nossos objectivos traçados, a interacção com os angolanos, tornando assim o programa em muito mais do que uma colectânea de imagens.

programme.title: Política And Religião - Ep. 9
programme.desc: O programa terá a presença do Apóstolo Jorge Tadeu, onde serão abordados vários temas da atualidade sobre a POLÍTICA vs o que a BÍBLIA fala.

programme.title: A Minha Caminhada Com Deus - Ep. 43
programme.desc: Durante uma breve entrevista pode acompanhar o percurso de vida de alguém que foi tocado por Deus. Assista a histórias de vida veridicas com testemunhos e experiências de vida incriveis que quem sabe podem ajuda lo também na sua caminhada.

programme.title: Vila Ideal - Ep. 91
programme.desc: O programa Infantil VILA IDEAL ensina de uma forma divertida princípios básicos morais e cívicos às crianças, promovendo a amizade, a obediência, a partilha, o amor ao próximo. Os conteúdos de cada programa são temáticos, com a interação dos vários personagens.

programme.title: Superbook T5 - Ep. 7
programme.desc: Superbook ou Superlivro, é uma série anime produzida pela CBN nos Estados Unidos que narra os acontecimentos do Antigo e Novo Testamento da Biblia.
